violations.text: The hand-washing sink in the kitchen was blocked by (trash can). A hand-washing sink shall be accessible at all times for employee use. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 07/27/2026

(Various food product) was observed held at (118-123 ) degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be maintained at 135 degrees Fahrenheit or above except during preparation, cooking, or cooling.PIC reheated during inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/27/2026
(Food product ) were observed stored on the floor in the (walk in freezers and coolers ). Food must be stored at least 6 inches above the floor. New Violation. Correct By: 07/27/2026
Cleaned and sanitized equipment and utensils are not stored inverted. New Violation. Correct By: 07/27/2026

The cutting boards in the (prepared food ) are very scratched and scored. Cutting blocks and boards that are subject to scratching and scoring shall be resurfaced if they can no longer be effectively cleaned and sanitized, or discarded if they are not capable of being resurfaced. New Violation. Correct By: 07/27/2026

Wood is used in the construction of (wood platform for grease trap ) in the (basement) area. Non-food contact surfaces of equipment that are exposed to splash, spillage, or other food soiling or that require frequent cleaning must be constructed of a nonabsorbent and smooth material. New Violation. Correct By: 08/17/2026
Walk in coolers door gaskets were observed in poor repair. New Violation. Correct By: 07/27/2026

The walls in the (produce ) are constructed of (concrete/cement). This material is not durable. Materials for wall surfaces shall be smooth, durable, easily cleanable, and non-absorbent for areas subject to moisture such as food preparation areas, walk-in refrigerators, ware-washing areas, and toilet rooms. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 08/10/2026

The (ceilings and walls(holes)) in the (retail and basement ) area is in poor repair. Observed damaged tiles and water stains. The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. Per PIC, ceiling is expected for repairs by 8/10. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 08/10/2026

Unnecessary and/or non-functional equipment or items were observed in the (basement and back outside ) area. Establishments shall be kept free of unnecessary and/or non-functional equipment and litter to prevent harborage conditions. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 08/03/2026

The floors and walls throughout the facility including walk in coolers have an accumulation of soil residue and/or food debris. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 07/27/2026

Spray bottle and food residue were observed in the hand-washing sink. A hand-washing sink must not be used for purposes other than hand washing.PIC informed. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 05/07/2025
The non-food contact surfaces of the (retail food storage shelves ) have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. New Violation. Correct By: 05/14/2025

The floors under retail shelves and walk in freezer have an accumulation of soil residue, food debris, and/or icebuild. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 05/14/2025

Unnecessary and/or non-functional equipment or items were observed in the (back outside and refuse) area. Establishments shall be kept free of unnecessary and/or non-functional equipment and litter to prevent harborage conditions. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 05/21/2025

(Various food product ) was observed held at (46-54 ) degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling.PIC voluntarily disposed of food product. See disposal. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 04/29/2025
Dairy refrigerator observed in poor repair. Observed ambient temperatures at 50DF. PIC made service call during the inspection. New Violation. Correct By: 04/29/2025
3 bay sink in the dept dept observed in poor repair. At time of inspection, PIC scheduled a service call for repair. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 04/29/2025
The (floor ) throughout retail area is in poor repair.Observed damage or missing flooring. The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 05/29/2025
The floor and wall junctures in the (kitchen ) do not have coving. The floor and wall junctures must be coved and closed to no larger than 1/32nd of an inch. New Violation. Correct By: 05/13/2025
The (ceiling ) in the (retail ) area is in poor repair.Observed missing and water stain tiles. The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 05/13/2025
